name: MigrateOneDriveShortcuts
label: Migrate OneDrive root shortcuts to the Shortcuts folder
helpText: Finds SharePoint library shortcuts sitting in each user's OneDrive root and moves them into the Shortcuts folder (PATCH move into special/shortcuts), matching the optional Microsoft UI location.
executiveText: Keeps employee OneDrive roots tidy by moving SharePoint library shortcuts into the dedicated Shortcuts folder instead of leaving them scattered among personal files.
docsDescription: Over time Add shortcut to OneDrive can leave many remote library links in the OneDrive root. Microsoft also supports placing those links in an optional Shortcuts folder. Each enabled member user's OneDrive root is listed (batched, with Prefer Include-Feature=AddToOneDrive) into the OneDriveRootShortcuts cache, refreshed when older than 3 hours; remoteItem shortcuts still outside Shortcuts are moved into special/shortcuts. Users without a provisioned OneDrive are skipped.
